name: Pixel bloom reveal
description: A logo-sting loop: squares pop out from the centre along a sunflower spiral, the bloom holds and shimmers, then it spins away into pixel dust from the edge in. On a clear background; works as a loader.

name: Pixel bloom transition
description: Squares on a sunflower spiral grow out from the centre, each carrying the next picture, until they cover the frame; a glow rides the growing edge. Loops back and forth; or turn Animate off and set Progress.

name: Pixel bloom
description: Rounded squares on a sunflower spiral, big at the bright centre and shrinking to pixel dust toward the edge, turning slowly while a shimmer ripples outward. On a clear background, for logos, headers and loaders.

name: Ripple dot
description: Just a dot and its waves: a single dot swelling with the bass, thin rings rippling out from it whose brightness at each distance is the spectrum (bass close, treble far), and one brighter ring on each beat.

name: Spell trace
description: Any shape or word traced in a hairline of light, as by a wand: a spark sweeps round its outline leaving a fading trail and a few drifting sparkles, a single ring of dots round it shows the spectrum, and each beat sends one soft ring of light out.

name: Arcane sigil
description: Any shape or word as a magic portal: arcane light swirling inside it, rings of glowing runes hugging its outline (one to a band of the spectrum, turning alternate ways), a tilted ring of runes orbiting it in front and behind, motes of light spiralling in and wisps curling up; each beat sends a pulse out through the runes.

name: Black hole silhouette
description: Any shape or word as a black hole: an accretion disk of the spectrum hugging its outline (treble close in, bass far out), lensed up over the top and under the bottom, a photon ring tracing its edge and the stars bent round it, flashing on each beat.

name: Nebula pillars
description: Dark pillars of dust in a glowing nebula, its gases lit by the music: red by the bass, teal by the mids, blue by the treble; on each beat a newborn star in a pillar's head flares and lights its edges.

name: Pulsar
description: A spinning neutron star wrapped in loops of magnetic field, one to a band of the spectrum, sweeping two lighthouse beams round; each beat whites out the frame as a beam crosses it.

name: Plasma globe
description: A plasma lamp: lightning filaments crackling from the centre to the glass, one to a band of the spectrum, jagged with the treble; on each beat they all leap to one spot on the glass as if a finger touched it.

name: Solar prominence
description: The edge of the sun up close: a boiling surface, and arches of glowing plasma rising off it, one to a band of the spectrum; on each beat one of them snaps in a flare of light.

name: Saturn rings
description: A ringed planet whose rings are the spectrum, bin by bin, each ringlet's density following its band; the planet shadows the rings, the rings stripe the planet, the treble stirs dark spokes and each beat sends a wave out through them.

name: Ferrofluid spikes
description: A puddle of glossy black magnetic fluid standing up in hexagonal spikes: the spectrum sets their height from the middle (bass) out (treble), each beat pulses the magnet and the treble sets the tips swaying.

name: Fractal pulse
description: A flight down a tunnel bored through an endless 3D fractal: the bass reshapes it, the treble lights its edges and each beat lurches the camera forward.

name: Neon skyline
description: A synthwave city whose towers are the equaliser: a striped sun pulsing with the level, a neon grid racing with the bass, and windows that flicker on every beat.

name: Aurora curtain
description: Curtains of northern lights over mountains and a still lake: the spectrum lifts the curtain left to right, the bass sways it, the treble shimmers its lower edge and each beat sends a pulse up the folds.

name: Liquid chrome
description: A speaker cone of mirror-like liquid metal in a studio: the bass pumps its middle, the spectrum ripples its surface, and each beat splashes drops off it.

name: Cymatics
description: Sand on a vibrating metal plate gathering into Chladni figures: the music picks the pattern, simple for low notes and intricate for high ones, and every beat throws the sand.

name: Black hole spectrum
description: A black hole whose accretion disk is the spectrum: bass on the outer rings, treble by the horizon, bent over and under the hole by gravity, its photon ring flashing on each beat.

name: Eyecatch
description: An anime eyecatch card, the bumper either side of an ad break: two diagonal colour bands slash across from opposite sides, a starburst spins open and the show's title slams in over it with its subtitle, holds, then everything sweeps away.
